projects.name: Reading handwritten Arabic prescriptions
projects.description: Final-year graduation project (team of 3) to read handwritten Arabic medical prescriptions. Photographed and labelled 4,200 prescription lines with pharmacy students, resolving labelling disagreements and removing blurred images. Preprocessed images via straightening, cropping and binarisation, and augmented the dataset with rotations and ink-thickness changes. Trained a convolutional-recurrent network with CTC loss in PyTorch on a university GPU server, reducing character error rate from 31% (off-the-shelf OCR) to 9.8%. Conducted a grid search over 36 hyperparameter settings tracked with Weights & Biases. Evaluated results using character and word error rate on a held-out set from unseen pharmacies, with error breakdown by drug-name length. Deployed the model behind a FastAPI service for browser-based photo uploads. Accepted as a poster at a Saudi student research conference (2026).
